notes: Four distinct movable parts are supported. Their open intervals overlap in a nested pattern: refrigerator, two cabinet leaves, then drawer; they are subsequently closed in reverse order. The initial camera survey contains no additional manipulation.
scene_description: A compact kitchen containing a stainless-steel refrigerator, electric range, upper wooden cabinets, and a narrow drawer unit. The user opens the refrigerator, separately opens both leaves of the cabinet above the cooktop, opens a drawer beside the range, and later closes these parts.
